upload.title: Upload document
upload.allowed: Accepted: PDF, JPG, PNG, DOCX, TXT, CSV and MD (up to 25 MB).
upload.duplicate: An identical file already exists in this workspace: “{{name}}”. Upload anyway?
upload.sameName: A document named “{{name}}” already exists in this folder with different content. What would you like to do?

status.storageOff: File storage is not configured: uploads are unavailable.
status.offline: You are offline. Uploading and editing require a connection.

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Invalid email or password, or session expired.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: File is over the 25 MB limit.
errors.FILE_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The file content does not match the declared type. The file was discarded.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.CONFLICT: Conflicting operation (for example, email already registered).
errors.DUPLICATE_FILE: An identical file already exists in this workspace.
errors.CONSENT_REQUIRED: You must authorize in-browser OCR before continuing.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Could not download the file to process it in this browser.
errors.OCR_FAILED: OCR failed in this browser. Try a smaller file.

folders.name: Folder name
folders.confirmDelete: Delete the folder “{{name}}”? It must be empty.

search.label: Keyword search across documents
search.none: No matching passage found. Search only covers documents with extracted text.
search.hasMore: There are more results; refine your search.
search.likeMode: Simplified search is active (no text index): accents are not ignored and it may be slower.
search.disclaimer: Keyword search; natural-language questions need external AI (off by default).

document.confirmDelete: Delete “{{name}}” and all its versions? This cannot be undone.

extraction.title: Text extraction
extraction.byText: Read from the file's text layer in your browser (no AI). Check it against the original.
extraction.byOcr: Recognized by experimental in-browser OCR. It may contain errors: check it against the original.
extraction.pending: The text has not been extracted yet.
extraction.failed: Could not extract readable text from this file (unreadable, protected or too large).
extraction.needsOcr: This file has no selectable text (image or scanned PDF). You can try in-browser OCR.

preview.title: Preview
preview.pdfFailed: Could not load the PDF preview. Use “Download”.
preview.docxNote: Text only: layout, tables and images of the DOCX are not reproduced.

ocr.title: In-browser OCR (experimental)
ocr.explain: Recognition runs on your computer; the document is not sent to third parties. The result is an automatic transcription and must be checked.
ocr.limitCdn: The OCR engine and language data are downloaded from the public jsDelivr CDN; no document content is sent.

block.mobile: In-browser OCR is not available on phones and tablets.
block.image_too_large: Image above {{mb}} MB: shrink the file to use OCR.
block.unsupported: This file type does not use OCR.

ocr.consent: I understand it is experimental and authorize running OCR in this browser.
ocr.done: Text recognized and saved as a transcription.
ocr.noNewText: No new text was recognized on these pages; the text already saved was kept.

analysis.title: Structured analysis
analysis.intro: Fields found by patterns (regex and heuristics) in your browser; the server re-checks each one against the text before saving it. This is not AI and not legal, accounting or tax advice.

status.none: This document has not been analyzed yet.
status.stale: The analysis belongs to an earlier version. Analyze again for the current version.

analysis.needsRun: Analyze the document to see this content.
analysis.rejected: {{n}} item(s) did not match the stored text and were discarded.
analysis.truncated: {{n}} occurrence(s) beyond the limit were not saved.
analysis.label: label
analysis.noFields: No field matched the patterns. That does not mean the document has no data: the patterns are limited (see limitations).

warn.address: Address detected by heuristic — please confirm

quick.note: Answers are built only from extracted fields, each with page and snippet. This is not a natural-language question.
quick.none: Not found among the extracted fields. That does not prove the document lacks this information.

search.label: Keyword in this document
search.disclaimer: Keyword search; natural-language questions need external AI (off by default).
search.none: No snippet found in this document.

summary.aiOff: External AI is off by default, so clause or obligation summaries are unavailable.
summary.empty: Not enough sentences (or detected dates, in chronological mode) to summarize.
summary.truncated: Long document: only the first 500 sentences were considered.

issues.note: Each item applies a fixed rule and shows page and snippet. The category describes the rule, it is not legal, accounting or tax advice, and no items does not guarantee the document is correct.
issues.none: No inconsistency found by the rules.

rule.missing_annex_reference: The text mentions “{{annex}}”, but no document in the workspace has that annex in its name

analysis.similarWarn: Possibly similar — not an exact copy (SimHash, Hamming distance ≤ {{max}}).
analysis.reportedByBrowser: reported by the browser (not re-checked by the server)
